hosts.title: Connect to a server
hosts.subtitle: Enter the address your friend shared, or start your own server on this computer.
hosts.addressHint: E.g. 192.168.1.20:47820 or a tunnel URL https://…trycloudflare.com (the app can join through tunnels too)
hosts.unreachable: Could not reach the server. Check the address and port.
hosts.localDesc: Run the NooXCord server on this computer so your friends can connect to you.
auth.remember: You stay signed in on this device.
guild.createDesc: A new place to hang out with your friends.
guild.name: Server name
guild.joinDesc: Enter the invite code you were sent.
guild.inviteDesc: Share this code. It is valid for 7 days.
guild.inviteLinksHint: Local network and Hamachi links cannot use the microphone in a browser; enter these addresses as the server address in the NooXCord app instead.
guild.leaveConfirm: Are you sure you want to leave {guild}?
guild.deleteConfirm: {guild} and all of its messages will be deleted permanently.
guild.emptyDesc: Create a server or join one with an invite code.
tunnelSwitch.label: Switch to tunnel mode
tunnelSwitch.failed: The tunnel could not be reached
err.voiceUnstable: The connection drops once voice starts; this call continues over WebSocket.
err.voiceUnstableTunnel: The connection drops once voice starts; this call continues over WebSocket. "Switch to tunnel mode" above the channel list should be more stable.
channel.name: Channel name
channel.kindTextDesc: Share messages, images, files and links
channel.deleteConfirm: #{channel} and all of its messages will be deleted.
chat.noPermission: You are not allowed to send messages here.
chat.welcomeDesc: This is the start of the channel.
chat.editing: Editing message · Esc to cancel, Enter to save
members.banConfirm: Ban {user}? They cannot rejoin with an invite.
roles.name: Role name
roles.default: Default role: everyone has these permissions.
settings.title: Settings
settings.logoutDesc: Ends the session on this device.
conn.sessionExpired: Your session expired, please log in again.
voice.joinDesc: Talk with everyone in this channel and watch streams.
voice.suppressed: You are not allowed to speak in this channel
stream.title: Share your screen
stream.audioDesc: NooXCord's own sound (other people's voices) is never sent.
stream.audioWeb: Share tab/system audio (if the browser allows it)
stream.tunnelQualityDesc: Quality sent to people watching through the tunnel (phones). High: full quality (a viewer whose connection cannot keep up drops to low for a while). Low: half resolution, less upload.
stream.webPicker: The browser will ask which screen or window to share next.
settings.pttHint: In the desktop app this also works while a game has focus.
settings.noiseHint.off: Your microphone goes out as is.
settings.noiseHint.browser: The browser's built-in suppressor: lowers steady hum, barely touches keyboard and fan noise.
settings.noiseHint.rnnoise: RNNoise: an AI model that cleans up fans, AC, keyboard and background hum. Light on CPU (recommended).
settings.noiseHint.gtcrn: GTCRN: a newer, stronger model that also suppresses dogs, TV and crowds. Uses more CPU.
settings.overlayDesc: Shows who is talking on top of your game while you are in voice. Shortcut: Ctrl+Shift+O
settings.devicesHint: Microphone permission is needed to see device names.
net.hostDesc: Others connect to the server on this computer. Voice and streams use the main port + 1.
net.portFree: Available (the voice port is free too).
net.portFreeMediaBusy: The main port is free but voice port {port} is in use.
net.portOwn: This port is used by the NooXCord server right now.
net.portPrivileged: Ports below 1024 need administrator rights; pick one between 1024 and 65534.
net.mediaPortHint: Voice and stream port: {port} (UDP and TCP). If Windows Firewall asks, allow it for private networks.
net.hamachiOn: Hamachi network connected; this address is for your friends on Hamachi.
net.hamachiNoIp: The Hamachi service is running but the adapter has no address. Join a network in Hamachi.
net.hamachiHint: If you turned Hamachi on after starting the server, restart the server so voice works over Hamachi too. The service button asks for administrator approval.
net.allowGuestsDesc: Browsers and phones join with just a nickname. Guests cannot stream, take remote control or manage the server.
net.cloudflareDesc: No account needed. The link changes every time.
net.devtunnelDesc: Sign in with GitHub once. The link stays the same.
net.devNotInstalled: The Dev Tunnels tool is not installed (downloaded from Microsoft, ~30 MB).
net.devCode: Enter this code on the page that opened:
net.devNewUrlConfirm: The current tunnel will be deleted and a new link created. People using the old link cannot get in.
net.devLimits: Dev Tunnels has a monthly usage limit; streams can use it up quickly. On the first visit in a browser Microsoft shows a warning page; "Continue" gets past it.
net.tunnel_on: Tunnel open · reachable from the internet
net.copyShortcut: Shortcut: Ctrl+Shift+L copies the link from anywhere.
net.cloudflareChanges: This link changes every time the tunnel opens.
net.publicWarning: Anyone with the link can join as a guest. Setting a guest password is recommended.
net.copyOnChange: Copy the new tunnel link automatically
net.tunnelMediaHint: For people coming through the tunnel, voice and streams go over WebSocket ("tunnel mode", slightly higher delay). In tunnel mode you can watch streams but not start one.
auth.guestHint: If you used this name before, you continue as the same person.
mobile.pickText: Pick a text channel in the Servers tab.
mobile.pickVoice: Tap a voice channel in the Servers tab.
voice.tunnelModeDesc: Voice and video arrive over WebSocket through the tunnel; the delay is a bit higher. Screen sharing in this mode is limited to 720p, without audio.
remote.controllingHint: Your mouse and keyboard go to the stream. Use the button to stop.
remote.frame: {user} is in control · Ctrl+Alt+Shift+Esc to stop
remote.unavailable: Remote control could not start on this computer.
remote.uacNote: Apps running as administrator cannot receive input (Windows restriction).
dm.title: Direct messages
dm.empty: No direct messages yet. Right-click a member and pick "Send message".
dm.pick: Pick a conversation on the left.
main.err.portRange: The port must be between 1024 and 65535.
main.err.hostTimeout: The server could not start (timed out).
main.err.portBusy: Port {port} is in use. Try another port.
main.err.startHostFirst: Start the server on this computer first.
main.tunnel.copied: The link was copied to the clipboard.
main.tunnel.timeout: The tunnel did not open within 45 seconds. Check your internet connection.
main.tunnel.noCloudflared: cloudflared.exe was not found. Try reinstalling the app.
main.tunnel.badSignature: The downloaded file's Microsoft signature could not be verified; it was not used.
main.tunnel.devMissing: The Dev Tunnels tool is not installed. Use "Download tool" first.
main.tunnel.devLogin: Sign in with GitHub for Dev Tunnels first.
main.tunnel.devCreateFailed: Could not create the dev tunnel: {msg}
main.overlay.fsBody: The game is in exclusive full screen. To see the overlay, pick "Borderless window" in the game's display settings.
notify.title: Notifications
notify.desktopDesc: Notify me about direct messages and when someone mentions me (@username).
notify.dndNote: No notifications are shown while your status is "Do not disturb".
settings.closeToTrayDesc: Closing the window keeps NooXCord running in the tray (voice, hosting and notifications continue).
settings.openAtLoginDev: Only available in the installed app.
update.title: Updates
update.ready: Version {version} is ready. It installs when you restart.
update.devOnly: Automatic updates only work in the installed app.
update.popupReadyDesc: Restart now, or it installs by itself when you close the app.
backup.title: Server backups
backup.desc: The database of the server hosted on this computer is backed up every day; the last 7 backups are kept.
backup.importConfirm: The server data will be replaced with the selected backup and the server restarts. The current data is backed up first.
backup.invalid: The selected file is not a NooXCord backup.
err.voiceJoin: Could not join the voice channel.
err.voiceFallbackWs: A direct voice connection failed; switching to tunnel mode (higher delay).
err.voiceMediaPort: Voice could not connect. The media port (main port + 1, UDP/TCP) must be reachable.
err.voiceReplaced: You joined voice from another device.
err.voiceRemoved: You were removed from the voice channel.
err.voiceRejoin: Could not reconnect to the voice channel.
err.micDenied: Microphone permission was denied; you can only listen.
err.micMissing: No microphone found; you can only listen.
err.micFailed: The microphone could not be opened; you can only listen.
err.sysAudioUnsupported: System audio cannot be captured on this computer; the stream started without sound.
err.sysAudioFailed: System audio could not start: {msg}. The stream is silent.
err.mediaFailed: The media connection could not be made.
err.wsNoEncoder: This browser cannot send the microphone in tunnel mode; you can only listen.
err.wsNoOpus: No Opus encoder; you can only listen.
err.sendFailed: The message could not be sent.
dm.welcomeDesc: This is the beginning of your direct messages with {user}.
net.firewallOn: Incoming connections are allowed on private networks (NooXCord + media server).
net.firewallOff: No rule. If others cannot connect over LAN/Hamachi, allow it (asks for administrator consent).
net.firewallFailed: The firewall rule could not be added (was consent denied?).
guild.joinGuestDesc: Paste the invite code or link you got from the server owner.
guild.emptyGuestDesc: Join a server with an invite code.
settings.muteKeyNone: Not set — click and press a key
settings.muteKeyHint: Works while in voice, even with a game in front. A key, a combination (Ctrl+Shift+M) or a middle/side mouse button can be used. Esc: cancel.
settings.muteKeyHintWeb: In the browser it only works while this tab is in front.
err.camBusy: The camera is in use by another app.
err.camNoEncoder: This browser cannot send a camera in tunnel mode (no WebCodecs H.264 encoder).
stream.tunnelNote: You are in tunnel mode: the stream goes out at up to 720p / 15 fps; audio is sent when available.
err.screenNoEncoder: This browser cannot stream in tunnel mode (no WebCodecs H.264 encoder).
err.streamAudioTunnel: Stream audio could not be sent through the tunnel; streaming without sound ({msg}).
